# guidance targets — `features/billing/steps/`

## Project layout

    features/billing/steps/
    └─ [step=0000]_[t=a+].sql 0+  a step

A count after a pattern, such as `0+` or `1+`, is the fewest matching names that must exist.

In `[step=0000]`, the text after `=` is a mask: each character matches one character of the name. `0` matches a digit and `a` a lowercase letter. `+` repeats the element before it one or more times. `espalier help matching` has the full grammar.

## `[step=0000]_[t=a+].sql` — a step

Inherits `features/[feature]/steps/[step=0000]_[t=a+].sql`, whose guidance in `../../AGENTS.MD` applies here.

No groups are declared here beyond the inherited `step` grouping's.
